title: IAF Airmen Group Y Recruitment 2025 Notification Out Apply Now
intro:
Author: Sarkari Exam Team
Tag: 12th / Diploma Pass Job
fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Indian Air Force (IAF) has announced a recruitment rally for male candidates, including Indian and Gorkha, to join as Airmen in Group ‘Y’ (Non-Technical) for the Medical Assistant Trade. Rally for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 has started from 29 January 2025 & the rally end date 06 February 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Indian Air Force (IAF)

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment Rally 2025

Important Dates

  • Rally Start Date : 29 January 2025
  • Rally Last Date : 06 February 2025

Application Fee

  • No Fees For All Candidates

[adinserter block=”3″]

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • For 12th Passed Candidates :
  • Born Between : 03 July 2004 To 03 July 2008
  • Diploma / B.Sc. Holder (Unmarried) :
  • Born Between : 03/ July 2001 To 03 July 2006
  • Diploma / B.Sc. Holder (Married) :
  • Born Between : 03 July 2001 To 03 July 2004
  • Age Relaxation as per Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : NA

Rally Date Eligible States Rally Location
29-30 January 2025 All Districts of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka Maharaja’s College Ground, PT Usha Road, Shenoys, Ernakulam, Kochi, Kerala-682011, Reporting Time : 6:00 AM (Last Entry by 10:00 AM)
01-02 February 2025 All Districts of Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, and UTs of Puducherry & Lakshadweep
04-05 February 2025 All Districts of Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, and UTs of Puducherry & Lakshadweep

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti 2025 : Educational Qualification

  • 12th Passed with Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English (50% Marks) OR
  • Diploma / B.Sc. in Pharmacy (50% Marks).
  • Valid Registration from the State Pharmacy Council or Pharmacy Council of India is Mandatory at Enrollment.
  • All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://airmenselection.cdac.in/CASB/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Air Force before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.

Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Recruitment 2025 : Mode of Selection

  • Physical Fitness Test
  • Written Examination
  • Document Verification
  • Medical Examination

Important Question

Q. When will Recruitment Rally will Start for Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Sarkari Result Recruitment 2025?
Answer. Recruitment Rally have started from 29 January 2025.

Q. What is Last Date of Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Notification 2025?
Answer. The last date to apply online for this recruitment is 05 February 2025.

Q. What is Age Limit For Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Vacancy 2025?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this recruitment as per Air Force rules, see the post wise age information in the official information.

Q. What is Qualification For Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Online Form 2025?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, the candidate must have 12th / Diploma pass read the official information completely before applying.

Q. How to Apply For Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Bharti 2025?
Answer. To apply for this recruitment, first of all you have to go to the Official Sarkari Result which is SarkariExam.com and apply through this recruitment page. Through Sarkari Result Official you can apply for many government jobs.

Q. How to download the result of Air Force Airmen Group ‘Y’ Result 2025?
Answer. All those candidates who had given the exam for this recruitment can now download their result. To download your result, you can download it by entering registration number / roll number and DOB (Date of Birth). The official download link of the result will be made available in the important links above.

Q. What is Air Force Official Website?
Answer. The Official Website of Air Force is https://airmenselection.cdac.in/CASB/
